service_paths.note: Disconnect all pump lines, coupling and support. 650 mm is a study distance, not OEM instruction.
Pass through left opening X4440..5520 / Z1830..2540. Handling cart/hoist and personnel space unqualified.
Drain, disconnect and temporarily remove bulkhead/transition before translation.
Lift through the new crown opening. Hoist attachment, masses, rigging and overhead work procedure require review.

notes: All values are candidate layout geometry, not OEM dimensions.
Added fixtures require a new mass/CG and support-load reconciliation before release.
Brake compressor, reservoirs and valves are not sized or physically installed by this overlay.
